first.rationale: Competitor pricing pressure makes promotional_pricing tempting, but memory_73 explicitly warns it boosts SMB acquisition while materially harming 30-day retention—directly counter to the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue, so I verify that record before ruling it out rather than reacting to competitive pressure. Given onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation down 6% QoQ, simplify_onboarding (supported by memory_86 and memory_31 showing durable activation/time-to-value gains from shorter onboarding) directly targets the observed metric declines with a lower-risk, previously-validated lever. I verify memory_86 to confirm its original conditions match current self-serve context before committing capacity. I'm running this as a standard experiment rather than broad rollout since current market conditions (competitor entry pricing) differ from when memory_86 was consolidated, and the causal driver of the current dip isn't fully confirmed to be onboarding friction alone versus competitive displacement.
